# Calculate DHS

## Set functions

```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

process_internet_use <- function(file_names, gender) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store data frames
  list_of_dataframes_int <- list()
  
  # Define selected variables based on gender
  selected_vars <- if(gender == "male") {
    c("v000", "v005","v012", "v171a") %>% 
      sapply(function(x) ifelse(startsWith(x, "v"), paste0("m", x), x)) %>% 
      unlist()
  } else {
    c("v000", "v005", "v012", "v171a")
  }
  
  # Determine the variable name for internet use based on gender
  internet_use_var <- if(gender == "male") "mv171a" else "v171a"
  age_var <- if(gender == "male") "mv012" else "v012"
  
  # Loop over each file name
  for (file in file_names) {
    # Read in the data from the DTA file with selected variables
    data <- read_dta(file, col_select = selected_vars) %>%
      mutate(harm = ifelse(max(!!sym(age_var)) < 50,0,1)) %>%
      group_by(!!sym(selected_vars[1])) %>%
      mutate(original_row = n()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!!sym(age_var) < 50)
    
    # Process the data for internet use based on the gender-specific variable
    processed_data_int <- data %>%
      mutate(Int_use_in_12 = case_when(
        !!sym(internet_use_var) == 1 ~ 1,
        is.na(!!sym(internet_use_var)) ~NA,
        T ~ 0),
             Int_use_before_12 = case_when(
               !!sym(internet_use_var) == 2 ~ 1,
               is.na(!!sym(internet_use_var)) ~NA,
               T ~ 0),
             Int_use_forget = case_when(
               !!sym(internet_use_var) == 3 ~ 1, 
               is.na(!!sym(internet_use_var)) ~NA,
               T ~ 0)) %>%
      filter(is.na(!!sym(internet_use_var)) == F) %>%
      group_by(!!sym(selected_vars[1])) %>%
      summarise(Int_use_in_12 = weighted.mean(Int_use_in_12, !!sym(selected_vars[2]), na.rm = TRUE),
                Int_use_before_12 = weighted.mean(Int_use_before_12, !!sym(selected_vars[2]), na.rm = TRUE),
                Int_use_forget = weighted.mean(Int_use_forget, !!sym(selected_vars[2]), na.rm = TRUE),
                harm = mean(harm),
                original_sample_size = mean(original_row),
                harmonized_sample_size_int = n(),
                .groups = 'drop')
    
    # Store the processed data in the list with the file name as key
    list_of_dataframes_int[[file]] <- processed_data_int
    
  }
  
  # Combine all data frames into one
  combined_data_int <- bind_rows(list_of_dataframes_int)
  
  return(combined_data_int)
}

check_files_for_variable <- function(file_list, variable_name) {
  files_without_variable <- c()  # Initialize an empty vector to store file names
  
  # Check each file for the specified variable
  for (file in file_list) {
    data <- tryCatch({
      read_dta(file, n_max = 100)  # Try to read the first 1000 rows of the file
    }, error = function(e) {
      NULL  # Return NULL if there's an error reading the file
    })
    
    # If data is successfully read, check for the variable
    if (!is.null(data)) {
      # Check if the variable doesn't exist or only contains NA values
      if (!variable_name %in% names(data) || all(is.na(data[[variable_name]]), na.rm = FALSE)) {
        files_without_variable <- c(files_without_variable, file)
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(files_without_variable)  # Return the vector of file names
}


process_mobile_use <- function(file_names, gender) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store data frames
  list_of_dataframes <- list()
  
  # Define selected variables based on gender
  selected_vars <- if(gender == "male") {
    c("v000", "v005","v012", "v169a") %>% 
      sapply(function(x) ifelse(startsWith(x, "v"), paste0("m", x), x)) %>% 
      unlist()
  } else {
    c("v000", "v005","v012", "v169a")
  }
  
  # Determine the variable name for internet use based on gender
  mobile_use_var <- if(gender == "male") "mv169a" else "v169a"
  age_var <- if(gender == "male") "mv012" else "v012"
  # Loop over each file name
  for (file in file_names) {
    # Read in the data from the DTA file with selected variables
    data <- read_dta(file, col_select = selected_vars) %>%
      mutate(harm = ifelse(max(!!sym(age_var))< 50, 0, 1)) %>%
      group_by(!!sym(selected_vars[1])) %>%
      mutate(original_row = n()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!!sym(age_var) < 50)
    
    # Process the data for internet use based on the gender-specific variable
    processed_data <- data %>%
      filter(is.na(!!sym(mobile_use_var)) == F) %>%
      group_by(!!sym(selected_vars[1])) %>%
      summarise(mobile = weighted.mean(!!sym(mobile_use_var), !!sym(selected_vars[2]), na.rm = TRUE),
                harm = mean(harm),
                original_sample_size = mean(original_row),
                harmonized_sample_size_mobile = n(),
                .groups = 'drop') # Drop grouping for summarised df
    
    # Store the processed data in the list with the file name as key
    list_of_dataframes[[file]] <- processed_data
  }
  
  # Combine all data frames into one
  combined_data <- bind_rows(list_of_dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}
```

## Set function

```{r}
check_files_for_variable <- function(file_list, variable_name) {
  files_without_variable <- c()  # Initialize an empty vector to store file names
  
  # Check each file for the specified variable
  for (file in file_list) {
    data <- read_sav(file,n_max = 1000)
    
    # If data is successfully read, check for the variable
    if (!is.null(data)) {
      # Check if the variable doesn't exist or only contains NA values
      if (!variable_name %in% names(data) || all(is.na(data[[variable_name]]))) {
        files_without_variable <- c(files_without_variable, file)
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(files_without_variable)  # Return the vector of file names
}


internet_use_mics <- function(file_names, gender) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store data frames
  list_of_dataframes_int <- list()
  
  # Define selected variables based on gender
  selected_vars <- if (gender == "male") {
    c("MMT6C","MMT6F", "MMT9","MMT10","MWB4","mnweight")
  } else{
    c("MT6C","MT6F", "MT9","MT10","WB4","wmweight")
  }
  age_vars <- if (gender == "male") "MWB4" else "WB4"
  
  # Loop over each file name
  for (file in file_names) {
    # Read in the data from the DTA file with selected variables
    data <- read_sav(file, col_select = selected_vars) %>%
      mutate(harm = ifelse(max(!!sym(age_vars),na.rm = T) < 50,0,1),
             sample_size = n()) %>%
      filter(!!sym(age_vars) < 50)
    
    processed_data_int <- data %>%
      mutate(Int_use = case_when(
        !!sym(selected_vars[1]) == 1 | !!sym(selected_vars[2]) == 1 | !!sym(selected_vars[3]) == 1 ~ 1,
        is.na(!!sym(selected_vars[1])) & is.na(!!sym(selected_vars[2])) & is.na(!!sym(selected_vars[3]))  ~ NA,
        T ~ 0
      ),
      Int_use_in_3 = case_when(
        !!sym(selected_vars[4]) %in% c(1:3) ~ 1,
        is.na(!!sym(selected_vars[1])) & is.na(!!sym(selected_vars[2])) & is.na(!!sym(selected_vars[3]))  ~ NA,
        T ~ 0
      )) %>%
      filter(is.na(Int_use) == F) %>%
      summarise(Int_use = weighted.mean(Int_use, !!sym(selected_vars[6]), na.rm = TRUE),
                Int_use_in_3 = weighted.mean(Int_use_in_3, !!sym(selected_vars[6]), na.rm = TRUE),
                harm = mean(harm, na.rm = T),
                original_sample_size = mean(sample_size),
                harmonized_sample_size_int = n())
    
    # Store the processed data in the list with the file name as key
    list_of_dataframes_int[[file]] <- processed_data_int
    
  }
  
  # Combine all data frames into one
  combined_data_int <- bind_rows(list_of_dataframes_int)
  
  return(combined_data_int)
}

process_mobile_use_mics <- function(file_names, gender) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store data frames
  list_of_dataframes <- list()
  
  # Define selected variables based on gender
  selected_vars <- if(gender == "male") {
    c("MMT11", "MWB4","mnweight") 
  } else {
    c("MT11", "WB4","wmweight")
  }
  
  # Determine the variable name for internet use based on gender
  mobile_use_var <- if(gender == "male") "MMT11" else "MT11"
  age_var <- if(gender == "male") "MWB4" else "WB4"
  # Loop over each file name
  for (file in file_names) {
    # Read in the data from the DTA file with selected variables
    data <- read_sav(file, col_select = selected_vars) %>%
      mutate(harm = ifelse(max(!!sym(age_var),na.rm = T)< 50, 0, 1),
             sample_size  = n()) %>%
      filter(!!sym(age_var) < 50)
    
    # Process the data for internet use based on the gender-specific variable
    processed_data <- data %>%
      mutate(mb_use = case_when(
        !!sym(mobile_use_var) == 1 ~ 1,
        is.na(!!sym(mobile_use_var)) ~ NA,
        T ~ 0
      )) %>%
      filter(is.na(mb_use) == F) %>%
      summarise(mobile = weighted.mean(mb_use, !!sym(selected_vars[3]), na.rm = TRUE),
                harm = mean(harm, na.rm = T),
                harmonized_sample_size_mobile = n(),
                original_sample_size = mean(sample_size)) # Drop grouping for summarised df
    
    # Store the processed data in the list with the file name as key
    list_of_dataframes[[file]] <- processed_data
  }
  
  # Combine all data frames into one
  combined_data <- bind_rows(list_of_dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}
```

# Population data

```{r}
##population data
library(janitor)
library(readxl)

pop_data <- read_csv(here("data/national/adolescent_modelling/data_refresh/population_data/un_1950_2023_processed.csv"))

pop_data <- pop_data %>%
  mutate(pop_15_to_49_female = `15_19_f` + `20_24_f` + `25_29_f` + `30_34_f` + `35_39_f` + `40_44_f` + `45_49_f`,
         pop_15_to_49_male = `15_19_m` + `20_24_m` + `25_29_m` + `30_34_m` + `35_39_m` + `40_44_m` + `45_49_m`) %>%
  rename(survey_start = Year) %>%
  select(iso3, survey_start, pop_15_to_49_female, pop_15_to_49_male)

full_groundtruth <- full_groundtruth %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(country,
                               origin = "country.name",
                               destination = "iso3c"))

full_groundtruth_pop <- full_groundtruth %>%
  left_join(pop_data, by = c("iso3","survey_start")) 

full_groundtruth_update <- full_groundtruth_pop %>%
  mutate(internet_men = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(survey_type), "dhs") & (iso3 != "IND") ~ perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men,
    str_detect(tolower(survey_type), "dhs") & (iso3 == "IND") ~ 0.9944*perc_ever_used_internet_wght_age_15_to_49_men - 0.0227,
    str_detect(tolower(survey_type), "mics") ~ 0.9944*perc_ever_used_internet_wght_age_15_to_49_men - 0.0227),
    internet_wom = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(survey_type), "dhs") & (iso3 != "IND") ~ perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom,
    str_detect(tolower(survey_type), "dhs") & (iso3 == "IND") ~ 0.9717*perc_ever_used_internet_wght_age_15_to_49_wom - 0.0107,
    str_detect(tolower(survey_type), "mics") ~ 0.9717*perc_ever_used_internet_wght_age_15_to_49_wom - 0.0107),
    mobile_men = perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_age_15_to_49_men,
    mobile_wom = perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_age_15_to_49_wom) %>%
  mutate(internet_fm_ratio = internet_wom/internet_men,
         mobile_fm_ratio = mobile_wom/mobile_men) %>%
  rename(year = survey_start)

selected_groundtruth <- full_groundtruth_update %>%
  filter(survey_type != "itu") %>%
  select(iso3, country, year, survey_type, internet_men, internet_wom, mobile_men, mobile_wom, internet_fm_ratio, mobile_fm_ratio, pop_15_to_49_female, pop_15_to_49_male)

write_csv(selected_groundtruth, here("data/national/data_refresh/update_full_groundtruth.csv"))
```
